Name: I'm Vivek Rajput
Description: Crafting seamless experiences and bold visuals. College student by day, creative thinker, and aspiring innovator by night.

AboutPara1: I'm Vivek Rajput, a curious designer, coder, and a problem solver. Currently a student at Jabalpur Engineering College, but always exploring the limitless possibilities of creativity and technology.
AboutPara2: I thrive on transforming problems into solutions, ideas into reality, whether it's crafting digital interfaces, designing immersive visuals, or building websites that feel effortless to use.

project_tagline: Solving Invoice Chaos for Small Businesses
project_problem: Small businesses waste ~15 hours/week on manual invoicing.
project_highlights: Reduces invoice creation time by 70% using AI-powered data extraction
Prevents compliance errors through automatic E-way bill validation
Saves businesses ₹50,000+ annually in accounting costs
project_impact: Currently serving 200+ businesses, processing 5,000+ invoices monthly

project_tagline: Scaling Workshop Registration from 50 to 500+ Students
project_problem: JEC needed to modernize their manual workshop registration process.
project_highlights: Automated registration workflow, reducing admin time by 80%
Enabled real-time capacity tracking and instant confirmations
project_impact: Successfully onboarded 500+ students across 20 workshops with zero registration errors

project_tagline: Bringing Smart Farming to Rural India
project_problem: 70% of Indian farmers lack access to timely crop advice, leading to preventable crop failures.
project_highlights: Uses AI image recognition to detect crop diseases within seconds
Provides multilingual voice support for low-literacy farmers
Delivers real-time weather and market alerts
project_impact: Tested with 50+ farmers in rural Madhya Pradesh, detecting 15 crop diseases with 87% accuracy
project_tech: React Native, Gemini AI, Google Cloud Speech API
project_contributions: Built image upload and analysis flow
